rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with an expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but it overstates confidence in identifying a compact A-level ICM and describes some features/locations not clearly supported by this single image.
Integrates maternal age, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, male factor, partner age, endometrium, and ovarian response well, though some links such as paternal age to aneuploidy are stated a bit strongly.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, with conclusions tied to morphology and history; the main weakness is a somewhat pessimistic implantation estimate relative to the favorable 3AA morphology.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET, counseling on morphology vs aneuploidy, luteal support, and considering further workup after repeated failure/loss; minor overreach in suggesting RPL workup after a single miscarriage.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and future-cycle review, including SET, progesterone/luteal considerations, lifestyle advice, cavity/RPL review, sperm DNA fragmentation discussion, and PGT-A counseling.
